description: This file defines the ThreadRAII class, which manages a std::thread object to ensure proper joining upon destruction, implementing RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) pattern for thread management.

classes.name: ThreadRAII
classes.description: A class that manages a std::thread object, ensuring it is joined when the ThreadRAII object is destroyed, to prevent std::terminate due to unjoined threads.

methods.name: ThreadRAII(std::thread&& t)
methods.description: Constructor that takes an rvalue reference to a std::thread and takes ownership of it.

methods.name: ~ThreadRAII()
methods.description: Destructor that joins the thread if it is joinable, with exception handling.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the managed std::thread object.
